title: Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer — 9.5 L, 2 Zones, 6-in-1, DZ400EU
short_description: Ninja Dual Zone air fryer with 9.5 litres (2 x 4.75 L drawers), 2 independent cooking zones and 6 functions. Air fry, roast, bake and more — with dishwasher-safe baskets.
long_description: The Ninja Dual Zone Digital Air Fryer DZ400EU offers 9.5 litres total volume in two separate 4.75-litre drawers. Two independent cooking zones let you prepare two dishes at once with different settings. Six functions cover air frying, Max Crisp, roasting, baking, reheating and dehydrating. According to the manufacturer, the Air Fry function uses up to 75% less fat. The non-stick baskets are dishwasher safe and easy to clean. Ideal for families who want to cook flexibly and with less fat.
features: 6 functions (Max Crisp, air fry, roast, bake and more)
buying_angle: Practical for families who want to prepare two dishes at once and cook with less fat — from the popular premium brand Ninja.
